card.name: Words just before a dose or exposure term
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" after "times" or "of" in animal study comparisons, right before "human dose", "clinical dose" or "exposure". Also linking words and numbers in dose and concentration tables.

modes.label: Times the human dose
modes.description: The word "the" after a multiple or percentage in animal reproductive toxicity comparisons.
modes.example: Bortezomib administered to rabbits during organogenesis at a dose approximately 0.5 times<< the>> clinical dose of 1.3 mg
